en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Secessionist/Art Nouveau exhibition hall with ornate façades and tower-like corner elements decorated with floral motifs and large rose‑window style openings. A small figure walks in front of the building, and leafless trees can be seen in the background. Printed red text at the top identifies the location and the building; there is also a handwritten greeting in a dark ink.
